_meta.nota: Traducciones del portafolio 2027 (EN/FR/IT/PT) hechas a partir de data/portafolio.json; POR VALIDAR por el equipo de Espontáneos Travel. Regenerar si cambian los textos en español.

cacao.name: Cacao Tour
cacao.tagline: Colombia is internationally recognized as a producer of fine flavor and aroma cacao.
desc: Pick-up at the hotel to visit a cacao-producing farm, where the hosts share their artisanal legacy. During the tour, guests walk through the crops and learn the process from harvest to the making of cacao products. Visitors take part in the process and enjoy preparing and tasting a traditional drink. An authentic and unforgettable experience.
reco: Insect repellent and comfortable clothing are recommended.
Ideal for ages 4 to 80.
combina: Transfer in/out (morning arrival and afternoon departure)
Full day Cordillera. Ask about applicable discounts

frutas.name: Fruit Tour (pineapple, guava or citrus)
frutas.tagline: Quindío is a fruit pantry: travelers tour the farm starting at the seedbed, harvest the fruit with their own hands and transform it in a hands-on workshop.
desc: Pick-up at the hotel to begin the tour, which starts at the seedbeds, where visitors learn the techniques and ideal timing for growing guava. During the experience they discover the secrets of the fruit and help care for the plants. They can also pick fresh guavas and enjoy a hands-on workshop to prepare traditional products made from this delicious fruit.
reco: Insect repellent and comfortable clothing are recommended.
Ideal for ages 4 to 80.
The tour visits a pineapple, guava or citrus-producing farm.
combina: Transfer in/out (morning arrival and afternoon departure)

cana.name: Sugarcane and Trapiche (Cane Mill) Tour
cana.tagline: Panela is a symbol of the Colombian table, and Colombia is one of the world's largest producers and consumers of panela.
desc: Meet at the hotel to begin a tour of a panela-producing farm, full of sweetness and tradition, where visitors discover the hard rural work behind the production of panela, an emblematic Colombian product. The experience includes a visit to the sugarcane field to learn about the harvesting process, followed by a tour of the trapiche (cane mill), where the panela is made. Visitors can interact with the farmers and enjoy a tasting of this delicious product.
oper: Weekends 9:00 am - full production process; weekdays between 9:00 am - 2:00 pm, partial process
reco: Insect repellent and comfortable clothing are recommended.
Ideal for ages 4 to 80.
On weekends the full production process can be seen; on weekdays, only part of it.
combina: Transfer in/out (morning arrival and afternoon departure)

abejas.name: Bee Tour
abejas.tagline: Wearing a beekeeper suit, step into the apiary and learn from a local family how artisanal honey is extracted and why bees are key to coffee and the region's crops.
desc: Meet at the hotel for a charming tour through the mountains to a family farm that reveals the secrets of the world of bees. On this tour, travelers explore the apiaries and learn the artisanal honey extraction process, guided by a family passionate about their work. They also enjoy breathtaking scenery and an authentic experience that connects nature and tradition, ideal for all audiences.
reco: Insect repellent, comfortable clothing, long sleeves and hiking boots are recommended.
Do not wear perfume or scented creams.
When booking, send each participant's coverall size.
Ideal for ages 10 to 60.
Not suitable for people allergic to insects or bees.

campesino.name: Experiential Tour: Farmer for a Day
campesino.tagline: The most authentic way to experience the Coffee Cultural Landscape, a World Heritage Site: join the daily routine of a farming family (picking coffee, fruit and plantain, caring for the animals) and share their table.
desc: Meet at the hotel and head to a traditional farm for an experience that lets visitors immerse themselves in rural life, warmly welcomed by a farming family. With great hospitality, the hosts invite guests to discover farm chores such as picking coffee, fruit and plantains, caring for animals or planting. An opportunity to connect with rural roots and appreciate the essential work that sustains life in the city.
reco: Long-sleeved clothing and hiking boots; avoid wearing perfume or creams.

platano.name: Plantain Tour · Local Delicacies (Pueblo Tapao)
platano.tagline: Quindío is one of the country's leading plantain producers.
desc: The local community of the Pueblo Tapao district grows the best plantain in the country. This is an opportunity to learn everything about its cultivation, care, varieties and flavors directly from the growers, while hearing stories about this community project that showcases the local cuisine and culture of the region. Guests taste different preparations of this product: an authentic local experience.
reco: Insect repellent and comfortable clothing are recommended.
Ideal for ages 4 to 80.

artesanoswillys.name: Artisans · Making Willys Jeeps
artesanoswillys.tagline: The Jeep Willys, the 'Yipao', is the symbol of Quindío and part of the region's Cultural Heritage; the Yipao Parade in Armenia is unique in the world.
desc: The Jeep Willys, the 'Yipao', is the symbol of Quindío and part of the region's Cultural Heritage; the Yipao Parade in Armenia is unique in the world. In this workshop, travelers build their own miniature Willys and take home an icon of the Coffee Cultural Landscape.
reco: Comfortable clothing is recommended.
Ideal for ages 5 to 80.
Mobile activity: can be held at the hotel or venue where the passengers are staying.

artesanosaves.name: Artisans · Bird Making
artesanosaves.tagline: A workshop with an association of women heads of household from Armenia who created their own modeling paste to craft birds.
desc: A workshop with an association of women heads of household from Armenia who created their own modeling paste to craft birds. Each traveler molds and paints a bird of the region while the artisans explain how to recognize it in the wild, in the country with the most bird species in the world. Travelers take their piece home as a keepsake.
reco: Comfortable clothing is recommended.
Ideal for ages 5 to 80.
Mobile activity: can be held at the hotel or venue where the passengers are staying.

artesanosbalcones.name: Artisans · Balconies
artesanosbalcones.tagline: The colorful balconies and bahareque architecture are part of the value for which UNESCO declared the Coffee Cultural Landscape a World Heritage Site.
desc: The colorful balconies and bahareque architecture are part of the value for which UNESCO declared the Coffee Cultural Landscape a World Heritage Site. In this workshop, travelers recreate a typical balcony in miniature and take home a piece of that architecture.
reco: Comfortable clothing is recommended.
Ideal for ages 5 to 80.
Mobile activity: can be held at the hotel or venue where the passengers are staying.

artesanosarcilla.name: Artisans · Clay
artesanosarcilla.tagline: In Pijao or Circasia, local artisans teach how to work the clay they extract from the mountain rivers.
desc: In Pijao or Circasia, local artisans teach how to work the clay they extract from the mountain rivers. Travelers mold their own piece while listening to stories of the craft and learn about a process that takes weeks: nearly a thousand pieces are gathered before the kiln is fired, where they bake for up to 24 hours.
reco: Comfortable clothing is recommended.
Ideal for ages 5 to 80.

artesanoscesteria.name: Artisans · Basket-Weaving Workshop
artesanoscesteria.tagline: Filandia is renowned for its basket-weaving tradition, a craft passed down from generation to generation using vines and fibers from the region.
desc: Filandia is renowned for its basket-weaving tradition, a craft passed down from generation to generation using vines and fibers from the region. Travelers weave their own piece with a master artisan and get a first-hand look at a living tradition of the Coffee Cultural Landscape.
reco: Comfortable clothing is recommended.
Ideal for ages 5 to 80.
combina: Full day Filandia, Cocora and Salento

palmacera.name: Wax Palms in the High Andean Forest (Pijao)
palmacera.tagline: The wax palm is Colombia's national tree and the tallest palm in the world.
desc: Meet at the hotel and head to the town of Pijao, where we board a Jeep Willys for a one-hour journey along an unpaved rural road, followed by a 3 km climb on foot lasting 1 hour 30 minutes. Visitors discover how the wax palm grows and can observe more than 100 bird species. They also interact with local people and learn about conservation, gaining a deep understanding of the ecosystem as we immerse ourselves in the magical cloud forest and the majesty of the Andes mountains.
reco: Hiking clothes: comfortable, waterproof and long-sleeved.
Moderate difficulty, climb between 2,200 and 2,600 m a.s.l.
Ideal for ages 12 to 70.
Not suitable for people with a history of heart or respiratory conditions.

aves.name: Birdwatching and Bird Photography for Beginners
aves.tagline: Colombia is the country with the most bird species on the planet, and the Coffee Region is one of its best destinations.
desc: Meet at the hotel for a tour designed for beginners, in which visitors explore the habitat of the region's emblematic species. With basic use of binoculars and cameras, they learn to photograph birds such as the Andean motmot, Andean cock-of-the-rock, blue-gray tanagers, tanagers, emerald toucanet, woodpeckers, egrets and tropical kingbirds. The route through nature reserves lets guests connect with biodiversity and enjoy the magic of the surroundings.
reco: Insect repellent and comfortable, earth-toned, long-sleeved clothing are recommended.
Departure between 5:00 and 6:00 am.
Ideal for ages 12 to 70.

avesconocedores.name: Birds for Experts (specialized birdwatching)
avesconocedores.tagline: For experienced birders: outings to the best birding spots in the Coffee Cultural Landscape, where eBird records between 170 and 370 species per site,…
desc: For experienced birders: outings to the best birding spots in the Coffee Cultural Landscape, where eBird records between 170 and 370 species per site, with target species such as the Cauca guan, the yellow-eared parrot or the Tolima blossomcrown. The specialist guide designs the route according to the species each group is looking for. See the route sheets at the end of the table.
oper: Custom route based on the group's target species
reco: Clothing in green, brown or olive tones (no white or bright colors), long sleeves, rain gear and hiking boots.
If you have binoculars or a camera, bring them.
Insect repellent and water.
On high-mountain routes, thermal clothing.
Minimum 2 passengers.
Small groups are recommended; larger groups are split up.

barbasbremen.name: Nature Reserves · Barbas-Bremen
barbasbremen.tagline: Between Filandia and Pereira, Barbas-Bremen is one of the last Andean forest corridors in the region and home to a population of howler monkeys.
desc: Between Filandia and Pereira, Barbas-Bremen is one of the last Andean forest corridors in the region and home to a population of howler monkeys. It is the ideal place to hear and see them in the wild along forest and guadua bamboo trails.
reco: Insect repellent, comfortable clothing, rain gear and long sleeves are recommended.
Low, moderate or moderate-to-high difficulty depending on the passengers' fitness.
Ideal for ages 12 to 70.
Not suitable for people with a history of heart or respiratory conditions.

otunquimbaya.name: Nature Reserves · Otún Quimbaya
otunquimbaya.tagline: A Fauna and Flora Sanctuary of Colombia's National Natural Parks, in the Otún River basin.
desc: A Fauna and Flora Sanctuary of Colombia's National Natural Parks, in the Otún River basin. It is a refuge for the Cauca guan, a bird endemic to Colombia, and for howler monkeys: a protected Andean forest less than an hour from Pereira.
reco: Insect repellent, comfortable clothing, rain gear and long sleeves are recommended.
Low, moderate or moderate-to-high difficulty depending on the passengers' fitness.
Ideal for ages 12 to 70.
Not suitable for people with a history of heart or respiratory conditions.

rioblanco.name: Nature Reserves · Río Blanco
rioblanco.tagline: Río Blanco Reserve, minutes from Manizales, is one of Colombia's best-known birding destinations: it protects the water that supplies the city and is…
desc: Río Blanco Reserve, minutes from Manizales, is one of Colombia's best-known birding destinations: it protects the water that supplies the city and is famous for its antpitta feeders, highly sought after by birdwatchers from around the world.
reco: Insect repellent, comfortable clothing, rain gear and long sleeves are recommended.
Low, moderate or moderate-to-high difficulty depending on the passengers' fitness.
Ideal for ages 12 to 70.
Not suitable for people with a history of heart or respiratory conditions.

ranas.name: Night Experience: Frogs and Amphibians
ranas.tagline: At night and with a herpetologist, discover glass frogs, chocolate frogs and poison frogs in the forest streams.
desc: Meet at the hotel for a night experience offering a fascinating immersion into the world of amphibians and reptiles. On arrival at a nature reserve, visitors enjoy a two-hour guided walk through the forest and streams, focused on spotting frogs and other amphibians. An expert biologist leads the tour and shares his research; with luck, guests may see species such as the Pijao glass frog, the chocolate frog and the poison frog.
reco: Insect repellent, comfortable clothing, a change of clothes, rain gear and long sleeves are recommended.
When booking, send each passenger's shoe or boot size.
Moderate difficulty (mountain terrain, streams or rivers).
Ideal for ages 12 to 60.
Not suitable for people with knee or hip injuries.

orquideas.name: A World of Orchids
orquideas.tagline: With an orchidologist, tour the greenhouse and the baby-orchid «nursery», take part in a conservation planting and learn how to care for orchids at home.
desc: Meet at the hotel and head to a family farm for a unique experience discovering the biodiversity of orchids in a nature reserve. Accompanied by an expert orchidologist, visitors learn about the majesty, conservation and cultivation of these flowers. The tour includes the greenhouse, propagation areas and the “nursery” for baby orchids. The activity ends with a conservation action and personalized advice on caring for orchids at home.
reco: Insect repellent and comfortable clothing are recommended.
Ideal for ages 5 to 80.
Not suitable for people allergic to pollen or to stings from insects or pollinators.

cocoraacaime.name: Cocora Valley Trek · Acaime, House of the Hummingbirds
cocoraacaime.tagline: Cocora Valley is Colombia's most iconic landscape, with the highest concentration of wax palms in the country.
desc: Meet at the hotel and depart for Salento to visit the valley of the wax palm. Passengers enter the viewpoint before starting a moderate trek across streams, hanging bridges, cloud forest and waterfalls, enjoying birdsong and observing flora and fauna. After covering 5 km through primary forest, they reach the Acaime nature reserve, home of the hummingbirds, a magical setting to watch these pollinating species.
reco: Hiking clothes: insect repellent, rain gear, long sleeves and earth tones.
Moderate difficulty.
Ideal for ages 12 to 60.
Not suitable for people with a history of heart or respiratory conditions.

cocoraacaime2.name: La Carbonera · Wax Palm Sanctuary
cocoraacaime2.tagline: La Carbonera is home to one of the largest and best-preserved wax palm populations in the world, on the border between Quindío and Tolima and away from the crowds…
desc: Meet at the hotel to begin an unforgettable journey through the valleys of Quindío, home of the wax palm, Colombia's national tree. Aboard a Jeep Willys from Salento we start a 2-hour drive along a rural road; travelers then hike uphill for approximately 2 hours amid incredible scenery. After a delicious brunch at a farm, we continue admiring the wax palms and return downhill for approximately 1.5 hours to board the Willys back to Salento, where we transfer and continue to the hotel.
reco: Hiking clothes: shoes with good grip, comfortable waterproof clothing and a warm layer.
Moderate-to-high difficulty; maximum altitude 3,370 m a.s.l.
Ideal for ages 12 to 60.
Not suitable for people with a history of heart or respiratory conditions.

paramo.name: Páramo Hike · a Unique Ecosystem (Pijao)
paramo.tagline: Colombia has about half of the world's páramos, the «water factories» of the Andes. Walk among frailejones in the Páramo del Chilí, up to 3,800 m a.s.l.
desc: Meet at the hotel for a unique experience discovering the páramo ecosystem, a source of life and environmental balance in Colombia. The tour starts by 4x4 Jeep from Pijao and continues with a 6 km walk among frailejones, wetlands and crystal-clear streams, guided by local experts. Along the way, travelers learn about biodiversity and the role of the páramo in water regulation while enjoying a high-mountain setting.
reco: Thermal and waterproof clothing, shoes with good grip, energy snacks and plenty of water.
Moderate-to-high difficulty; maximum altitude 3,800 m a.s.l.
Ideal for ages 12 to 60.
Not suitable for people with a history of heart or respiratory conditions.

conexion.name: Total Connection: Wellness and Renewed Energy
conexion.tagline: A full day of wellness in nature: biomarker assessment, healthy lunch, the five-element Path of Life and a release massage.
desc: Meet at the hotel to begin a wellness experience in which visitors receive an assessment with biomarkers, a bioscanner and energy measurement. A healthy lunch follows, before the walk along the Path of Life, where connecting with the five elements renews body and mind. The experience ends with a liberating energy massage.
reco: Insect repellent, comfortable clothing and a warm layer, swimsuit and sandals are recommended.
Ideal for ages 18 to 80.

termales.name: Hot Springs: Santa Rosa, San Vicente or El Otoño
termales.tagline: The hot springs of the Coffee Region originate from volcanic activity in the Central Cordillera and emerge at around 70 °C.
desc: Meet at the hotel to visit, in the mountains of the coffee region, hot springs that emerge at 70° and are channeled into 40° pools, ideal for relaxing and relieving muscle pain. At these sites you can walk nature trails and receive treatments with waters and muds whose mineral properties are therapeutic for the body and skin.
incl: Entrance to the selected hot springs
reco: Insect repellent, swimsuit, towel and comfortable clothing are recommended.
Ideal for ages 6 to 80.
Not recommended for people with a history of heart conditions.
Check opening hours for weekends and high season.

senderovida.name: Path of Life · Inner Connection
senderovida.tagline: An introspective walk through the five elements (water, air, earth, fire and ether) guided by a wellness coach, ending with a massage.
desc: Meet at the hotel to begin a walk that invites guests to immerse themselves in the essence of the five elements: water, air, earth, fire and ether. Each step is a journey of inner connection while exploring landscapes that awaken the senses and revitalize the spirit. Ideal for those seeking introspection and harmony in an incomparable natural setting.
reco: Comfortable clothing.
Passengers choose their massage: release and harmony (muscular), marine renewal (full-body exfoliation) or lavender (deep relaxation of the head, face and neck).
Ideal for ages 18 to 80.

equino.name: Equine Therapy · Coach-Assisted
equino.tagline: Horses mirror the emotions of whoever stands before them; in this coach-led session, travelers experience a self-awareness exercise in a setting…
desc: Meet at the hotel and head to a countryside venue for the equine therapy activity. With their sensitivity, horses naturally reveal our inner world, guiding us to connect with our personal power; the experience acts as a mirror that shows who we are and who we want to be. At the end of the session, return to the hotel.
reco: Insect repellent and comfortable clothing are recommended.
The session is tailored to the initial diagnosis: assertive communication, empathy, coherence, self-awareness, trust, emotional and stress management, or conflict resolution.
Children under 13: family activity.
Ideal for ages 14 to 80.

yoga.name: Yoga Session in a Nature Reserve
yoga.tagline: Outdoor yoga, with the sounds of the forest and the coffee mountains in the background, led by a professional yogi.
desc: Meet at the hotel to visit a natural setting for a yoga session where tranquility meets inner balance. Through postures and breathing, participants achieve a deep connection with themselves and their surroundings, fostering mind-body harmony. Ideal for those seeking a break from stress and a boost of energy in a serene environment.
reco: Insect repellent and comfortable clothing are recommended.
Held at the nature reserve closest to the hotel, or at the hotel if its facilities allow.
Ideal for ages 18 to 80.

rituales.name: Holistic Wellness Rituals
rituales.tagline: Forest bathing and symbolic rituals with plants, incense and crystals, for special occasions: couples, birthdays, new beginnings or welcoming a baby.
desc: Meet at the hotel and head to a reserve for forest bathing and symbolic rituals using plants, incense, baths, crystals and other natural elements to promote well-being, healing and deep connection. Options include the Couples, Union, Birthday, Welcome to the World (baby), Women's, New Beginnings and Energy Cleansing rituals. Ideal for those who wish to renew their energy and open a new chapter in harmony.
reco: Insect repellent and comfortable clothing are recommended.
Held at the nature reserve closest to the hotel, or at the hotel if its facilities allow.
Ideal for ages 18 to 80.
combina: Transfer in/out (morning arrival and afternoon departure)

respiracion.name: Conscious Breathing and Ice Immersion
respiracion.tagline: Functional breathing, controlled cold exposure and bioenergetics with a professional therapist, in a natural setting in the Coffee Cultural Landscape.
desc: Meet at the hotel and head to a natural setting where travelers enjoy a transformative experience combining functional breathing, cold exposure and bioenergetics. Guided by a professional therapist, they discover how to activate their vital energy, calm the mind and release deep tension. In a safe, supported space, each participant enjoys a journey of 1:30 to 2 hours that turns stress into serenity and disconnection into vitality, taking home practical tools and an unforgettable memory of the Coffee Cultural Landscape.
reco: Comfortable clothing, swimsuit for the immersion and a towel.
Ideal for ages 18 to 80.

finca.name: Coffee Farm Visit
finca.tagline: Colombian coffee has a Designation of Origin, and the Coffee Cultural Landscape is a World Heritage Site.
desc: Meet at the hotel to visit a coffee farm, where the tour starts at the coffee seedbeds and visitors discover the secrets of cultivation. Walking through the coffee plantations, they learn about the varieties while hearing stories of a traditional farm. The experience includes a look at the wet-milling and drying process, ending with a cupping workshop ideal for distinguishing and enjoying the unique nuances of this iconic drink.
reco: Insect repellent and comfortable clothing are recommended.
Do not wear perfume or scented creams.
Ideal for ages 4 to 80.
combina: Transfer in/out (morning arrival and afternoon departure)
City tour in any of the cities

filandia.name: Filandia Tour
filandia.tagline: Filandia is one of the best-preserved towns in the Coffee Cultural Landscape: colorful balconies, bahareque architecture and a basket-weaving tradition that is still alive.
desc: One of the most authentic and best-preserved towns in the Coffee Cultural Landscape, where colorful architecture, colonial balconies and a peaceful atmosphere set the perfect stage for an in-depth cultural tour. During the experience, visitors walk its traditional streets, visit natural viewpoints overlooking the mountains and connect with local history and identity. Participants learn about the ancestral techniques of basket weaving, understand the cultural value of this craft and appreciate the handiwork passed down from generation to generation.
reco: Comfortable clothing and a rain jacket are recommended.
Ideal for ages 4 to 80.
combina: Transfer in/out (morning arrival and afternoon departure)

cocorasalento.name: Cocora Valley and Salento Tour
cocorasalento.tagline: Cocora Valley, with the wax palm, the national tree, is Colombia's most recognized image, and Salento is the oldest town in Quindío.
desc: Meet at the hotel and set off for the spectacular Cocora Valley, home of the majestic wax palm. Visitors can walk to impressive viewpoints or take part in a planting ritual (supplement applies). Includes a delicious lunch before exploring Salento, its charming Calle Real and its handicrafts, with time for shopping before returning to the hotel.
reco: Insect repellent, sunscreen, a cap, and comfortable clothing and shoes are recommended.
We suggest scheduling Monday to Friday due to the destination's carrying capacity.
Ideal for ages 4 to 70.

compartidocs.name: Shared Tour: Cocora Valley and Salento
compartidocs.tagline: The most practical and affordable way to see Cocora and Salento: daily departure from Armenia with a guide, interpretation of the cloud forest and the wax palm, and free time on Calle Real.
desc: Departure at 8:15 a.m. from Armenia to the Cocora Valley, with interpretation of the cloud forest and the wax palm. The guide explains the features and prices of the viewpoints (each passenger pays at the ticket office according to their choice). The guide accompanies the walk as far as the river; time in the valley is 2 to 3 hours. The group then returns to Salento for a historical tour, lunch, a visit to Calle Real and shopping. Return to Armenia at 4:00 p.m.
oper: Daily at 8:00 am, with prior booking
Departures from Armenia · meeting points: Plaza de Bolívar 8:00 am and Parque de la Vida 8:10 am
reco: Insect repellent, sunscreen, a cap, and comfortable clothing and shoes are recommended.
Operates from 2 passengers.
Bookings until 8:00 pm the day before.
Meeting points: Plaza de Bolívar 8:00 am and Parque de la Vida 8:10 am.
Ideal for ages 4 to 70.

cordillera.name: Full day Cordillera: Córdoba, Pijao and Buenavista
cordillera.tagline: The lesser-known Quindío: a day in the mountains, traveling rural roads to discover the authenticity of three mountain towns.
desc: Meet at the hotel to begin a tour of southern Quindío. We visit the town of Córdoba, known for the use and preservation of guadua bamboo. The experience continues in Pijao, known for being part of the Cittaslow movement, where we stroll its streets and hear local stories. We end in Buenavista, Quindío's viewpoint par excellence, with ideal views for photos and a tasting of an exquisite high-altitude coffee. A natural and cultural experience that combines scenery and local traditions.
reco: Insect repellent and comfortable clothing are recommended.
Ideal for ages 4 to 80.

fulldayfcs.name: Full day Filandia, Cocora Valley and Salento
fulldayfcs.tagline: Quindío's three must-sees in a single day: the wax palms of Cocora, Salento's Calle Real and Filandia's basketry, with lunch included.
desc: Meet at the hotel for a tour combining tradition and nature. In the Cocora Valley, guests admire the towering wax palms from a viewpoint; back in Salento, they stroll the colorful Calle Real and its craft shops. After lunch, the trip continues to Filandia, where they discover basket weaving and the galleries of master artisans, ending with a tasting of an exquisite regional coffee.
incl: Entrance to a viewpoint in Cocora
reco: Insect repellent and comfortable clothing are recommended.
We suggest scheduling Monday to Friday due to the destination's carrying capacity.
Ideal for ages 4 to 70.
combina: Experience with local artisans - BASKET WEAVING

pereira.name: Pereira City Tour
pereira.tagline: Pereira, the 'Pearl of the Otún', is the most dynamic city in the Coffee Region: the cathedral, the Plaza de Bolívar with Arenas Betancourt's Naked Bolívar, and the César…
desc: Meet at the hotel for a guided tour of Pereira, known as the Pearl of the Otún. The tour includes a visit to the majestic Cathedral and the Plaza de Bolívar, passing through the historic center. Guests cross the iconic Viaduct that connects Pereira with Dosquebradas and explore Avenida Circunvalar. The tour ends with free time for shopping in the city's most representative shopping areas.
reco: Insect repellent and comfortable clothing are recommended.
Ideal for ages 4 to 70.

manizales.name: Manizales City Tour
manizales.tagline: Manizales, built on mountainsides overlooking Nevado del Ruiz, has one of the tallest cathedrals in Latin America, which can be climbed via the Corredor Polaco.
desc: Meet at the hotel for a fascinating tour of Manizales, a city built on steep mountains and surrounded by imposing views of Nevado del Ruiz. Guests visit the historic center, including the iconic Cathedral Basilica, considered the tallest in Colombia. The tour also passes by the Plaza de Bolívar, the Balcón de Chipre and the Monument to the Colonizers. To finish, guests visit a viewpoint where they enjoy a delicious coffee tasting.
incl: Entrance to the cathedral's Corredor Polaco
reco: Insect repellent and comfortable clothing are recommended.
Ideal for ages 4 to 70.

armenia.name: Traditional Armenia City Tour
armenia.tagline: Armenia, the 'Miracle City', was rebuilt after the 1999 earthquake.
desc: Meet at the hotel for a tour of the “Miracle City”, where visitors learn about Armenia's progress since the earthquake 30 years ago. Stops include the Plaza de Bolívar, Calle Real, Parque Sucre and Parque Fundadores, where guests enjoy a single-origin specialty coffee. They also explore Parque de la Vida, home to great biodiversity, and finish with a visit to the Quimbaya Gold Museum.
incl: Visit to the Quimbaya Gold Museum
reco: Insect repellent and comfortable clothing are recommended.
Ideal for ages 4 to 70.
combina: Experience with local artisans - Bird workshop

cuyabro.name: City Tour: Cuyabro Art and Single-Origin Coffee
cuyabro.tagline: Armenia told through its street art: murals, graffiti and barranquismo, a sculptural technique born in the region, with works by artist Henry Villada.
desc: Meet at the hotel for this urban walk through the streets of Armenia, offering an immersion into Barranquismo, a local sculptural technique, and the art of graffiti. Visitors explore murals featuring stencil, poster art and realism, as well as works by artist Henry Villada, reflecting the natural and cultural landscape of the coffee region. The experience ends with a stop at a coffee shop to taste single-origin specialty coffees.
reco: Insect repellent and comfortable clothing are recommended.
Ideal for ages 4 to 70.

cartago.name: Community Tour in Cartago
cartago.tagline: Cartago, in northern Valle del Cauca, is Colombia's embroidery capital.
desc: Meet at the hotel to discover Cartago's cultural heritage and resilience on this inspiring community tour. Together with local young people, guests explore its cathedral and churches, followed by a unique embroidery Graffitour in Comuna Uno, which honors this craft. The experience includes a visit to a workshop house, where participants learn basic techniques and create a personal design, immersing themselves in the city's rich history and culture.
reco: Comfortable clothing is recommended.
Ideal for ages 6 to 80.

cabalgatamaria.name: River and Mountain Horseback Ride
cabalgatamaria.tagline: A horseback ride with a purpose: the horses are rescued and rehabilitated, and the hacienda, once a cattle ranch, is now a nature reserve committed to tourism…
desc: Meet at the hotel and head to a hacienda for this horseback ride guided by experienced cowboy hosts. It begins with an introduction to the activity, followed by a ride around the hacienda with stops to take in landscapes of guadua groves, pastures and rivers. Along the way, visitors enjoy impressive panoramic views. The experience ends with a delicious lunch at the hacienda house, in a warm and authentic atmosphere.
reco: Insect repellent, comfortable clothing, a hat and hiking shoes (they may get wet) are recommended.
Ideal for ages 12 to 60.
Not suitable for pregnant women or people with back problems; not recommended for children under 12.
combina: Coffee farm visit - Ask about applicable discounts

cabalgatadeluxe.name: Deluxe Horseback Ride in the Cordillera
cabalgatadeluxe.tagline: A premium ride on Arabian and Spanish horses through the mountains, with a training demonstration, native tree planting, a luxury picnic and a return by Willys with a mountain-style lunch.
desc: Pick-up at the hotel for an authentic experience in Pijao, in the mountains of the Central Cordillera. Travelers ride elegant Arabian and Spanish horses after an explanation of the breeds and training demonstrations. During the ride there are stops at crops and viewpoints, ending with a native tree-planting ritual and an outdoor picnic. The return to the chalet is aboard an iconic Jeep Willys, with a typical mountain-style lunch. An ideal activity to connect with nature and the coffee landscapes.
reco: Insect repellent, comfortable clothing, and a hat or cap are recommended.
Ideal for ages 12 to 60.
Not suitable for pregnant women or people with back problems.
Product certified under NTS AV 014 (horseback riding in adventure tourism) and equine good practices.
noApto: Not suitable for pregnant women or people with back problems.
combina: Experience with local artisans - Balconies or clay
Coffee farm visit - Ask about applicable discounts

parapente.name: Paragliding
parapente.tagline: See the Coffee Cultural Landscape from the air: a flight with certified pilots over mountains, coffee plantations and valleys, with video and photos included.
desc: Meet at the hotel and head to a wonderful viewpoint high in the mountains for this experience in the majestic setting of the Central Cordillera, where travelers enjoy a paragliding flight that combines adrenaline and spectacular views of the coffee landscapes. Led by certified pilots, the activity ensures safety as adventurers soar over mountains and valleys on a thrilling flight that connects them with nature. Ideal for those seeking a unique perspective of the Coffee Cultural Landscape.
reco: Comfortable clothing, lace-up shoes, sunglasses and a warm layer are recommended.
15 to 20-minute flight depending on weather conditions.
Ideal for ages 4 to 65.
Not suitable for people who have had recent surgery, pregnant women or anyone under the influence of psychoactive substances or alcohol.

paratrike.name: Paratrike
paratrike.tagline: Powered paragliding, suitable for people with reduced mobility: 360° views over Quindío and Valle del Cauca from Buenavista or Calarcá.
desc: Meet at the hotel and head to a take-off site for the paratrike activity (powered paragliding, suitable for people with reduced mobility). We then continue to the landing strip in Buenavista or Calarcá, as preferred. After equipment preparation and a briefing, the big moment of adventure in the clouds arrives, offering 360° views of the landscapes of Quindío and Valle del Cauca.
oper: Daily at 7:00 am and 10:00 am (subject to weather conditions)
reco: Comfortable clothing, lace-up shoes, sunglasses and a warm layer are recommended.
Suitable for people with reduced mobility.
15 to 20-minute flight depending on weather conditions.
Ideal for ages 4 to 65.
Not suitable for people who have had recent surgery, pregnant women or anyone under the influence of psychoactive substances or alcohol.

canopy.name: Natural Canopy Adventure
canopy.tagline: A canopy circuit among the treetops, about 15 minutes from Armenia: 16 platforms and more than 1,900 meters of aerial course with zip lines, bridges…
desc: A canopy circuit among the treetops, about 15 minutes from Armenia: 16 platforms and more than 1,900 meters of aerial course with zip lines, hanging bridges, climbs and lookout points, up to 30 meters above the ground. It is one of the most representative adventure activities in the Coffee Region, with strict safety controls and views of the Coffee Cultural Landscape.
incl: 16-platform circuit of more than 1,900 m: zip lines, hanging bridges, climbs and lookout points
reco: Closed lace-up shoes and comfortable clothing (long pants); no loose items in pockets.
Weather dependent: does not operate when it rains.
Minimum age: 7 years.

parquecafe.name: Parque del Café
parquecafe.tagline: The Coffee Region's most iconic theme park: coffee culture told through shows, a coffee trail, funicular, cable car and rides.
desc: Here, coffee comes to life and becomes the star of a world full of magic and fun. A place to enjoy exciting shows, a fascinating tour of the coffee world, a funicular ride and thrilling mechanical rides. It has a food court. Ideal for families, ages 4 to 70
reco: Insect repellent, comfortable clothing, a hat or cap and sunscreen are recommended.
Multiple Passport: height over 124 cm; Junior: children between 90 and 124 cm; Senior: over 70 years old.
Ideal for families, ages 4 to 70.

panaca.name: PANACA
panaca.tagline: The farming culture park, built on the premise 'without the countryside there is no city': more than 2.5 km of stations with farm animals and shows featuring horses, dogs…
desc: On this route of more than 2.5 km, under the premise “without the countryside there is no city”, you will discover different themed stations: Agronomy, Minor Species, Ostriches, Pig Farming, Felines, Agroecology and Integrated Farm, Canine and Equine, where you can interact with all of our domestic animals; you will also see 5 spectacular shows, featuring horses, dogs and piglets, among others. The park has a food court.
reco: Insect repellent, comfortable clothing, a hat or cap and sunscreen are recommended.
Children under 90 cm do not pay.
Ideal for families, ages 4 to 65.

recuca.name: RECUCA · Coffee Culture Tour
recuca.tagline: Here travelers dress as coffee pickers and live the coffee cycle like a traditional grower: picking, pulping, drying, hulling, roasting and grinding.
desc: RECUCA is the Coffee Culture Tour (Recorrido de la Cultura Cafetera), where visitors take on the role of coffee grower, from seed to cup, actively joining in the farm work. After picking coffee dressed in the clothes once worn by the region's farmers, they move on to processing, where they pulp, dry, hull, roast and grind the coffee just as traditional growers did.
reco: Insect repellent, comfortable clothing, a hat or cap and sunscreen are recommended.
Tours and cuppings every half hour, from 9:00 am to 3:00 pm.
Children under 90 cm do not pay.
Ideal for families, ages 4 to 65.
combina: Transfer in/out (morning arrival and afternoon departure)
Full day Cordillera - ask about applicable discounts

arrieros.name: Parque Los Arrieros
arrieros.tagline: A tribute to arriería (mule driving), the trade that settled and built the region: 8 artistic shows and 14 interactive activities to learn the history of the Coffee Region in a fun way.
desc: A place where visitors can enjoy a variety of fun and educational experiences around the culture of the arrieros (mule drivers), through artistic and cultural venues, exhibitions and entertainment areas that offer a wide range of options for an enjoyable experience, with 8 artistic shows and 14 interactive activities. The park has a restaurant.
reco: Insect repellent, comfortable clothing, a hat or cap and sunscreen are recommended.
Arrive before 10:00 am so as not to miss any of the shows.
Children under 90 cm do not pay.
Ideal for families, ages 4 to 65.

ukumari.name: Ukumarí Biopark
ukumari.tagline: One of the largest bioparks in Latin America, dedicated to conservation: spectacled bears, pumas, Andean birds and an African savanna with giraffes, lions and rhinos.
desc: A tour of Ukumarí Biopark, a place for wildlife conservation and rehabilitation where you can see species from the Andean region such as the spectacled bear, pumas, oncillas, macaws and a diversity of birds, among others, as well as African savanna species such as lions, giraffes, rhinos, tigers and buffalo, typical of that region, in their natural habitat.
reco: Insect repellent, comfortable clothing, a hat or cap and sunscreen are recommended.
Hours: Monday to Friday 8:00 am to 5:00 pm; Saturday 8:00 am to 2:00 pm.
Guided tours: 10:00, 10:30, 11:00 am and 1:00 pm.
Ideal for families, ages 4 to 65.
combina: San Vicente or Santa Rosa Hot Springs

botanico.name: Quindío Botanical Garden and Butterfly House
botanico.tagline: A research and conservation center for Quindío's native flora and fauna, with the largest national palm collection in Colombia and a butterfly house where you walk among butterflies.
desc: A tour of the botanical garden and butterfly house, which researches and educates… in order to conserve. The primary goal of the Quindío Botanical Garden Foundation is the conservation of native biota, that is, the plants, animals, fungi and microorganisms native to this region.
reco: Insect repellent, comfortable long-sleeved earth-toned clothing, a hat or cap and sunscreen are recommended.
Last entry 3:30 pm.
English-speaking guide at a supplement.
Ideal for families, ages 4 to 75.
combina: Full day Cordillera - ask about applicable discounts

laberinto.name: Mil Caminos Labyrinth
laberinto.tagline: One of the largest labyrinths in Latin America: more than 3 km of paths among 24,000 shrubs, in a space to contemplate, play and unplug.
desc: A tour of the Mil Caminos Labyrinth, a space dedicated to environmental education and biodiversity conservation, where you can explore one of the largest labyrinths in Latin America, walk more than three kilometers of paths surrounded by 24,000 copper leaf shrubs, connect with nature through contemplation, recreation and introspection, and enjoy an experience that raises awareness of the importance of protecting Quindío's native biota and its natural balance.
reco: Insect repellent, comfortable clothing, a hat or cap and sunscreen are recommended.
Open Tuesday to Sunday and public holidays, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm (last entry).
Ideal for families, ages 4 to 75.

siembra.name: Leaving a Mark: Tree Planting
siembra.tagline: Meet at the hotel and head to a nature reserve for a transformative experience in which participants connect deeply with nature through a planting…
desc: Meet at the hotel and head to a nature reserve for a transformative experience in which participants connect deeply with nature through a tree-planting activity in a nature reserve. Guided by local experts, they learn about native species, their ecological importance and the benefits of reforestation. Each tree planted is a step toward conservation, leaving a positive footprint on the ecosystem. An ideal experience for those who wish to contribute to caring for the environment.
reco: Comfortable clothing, rain gear, a warm layer and shoes with good grip are recommended.
Care of the planted tree is guaranteed for 5 years.
Ideal for ages 12 to 70.

cajaviajera.name: The Traveling Coffee Box
cajaviajera.tagline: A poetic performance that tells the story of coffee culture from its roots, with a coffee tasting.
desc: This experience is a staged performance that portrays coffee culture through an inspiring, poetic narrative, whose creator evokes the romanticism and roots of the region.
reco: Mobile activity: held at the hotel or venue where the passengers are staying.
Operates only in Spanish or with a translator.
Ideal for ages 12 to 80.

tallerrespiracion.name: Conscious Breathing Workshop
tallerrespiracion.tagline: Practices guided by a functional medicine expert and advanced Oxygen Advantage instructor to regulate the nervous system, improve sleep and reduce…
desc: A functional breathing and holistic wellness experience in the heart of Quindío: travelers are picked up at their hotel for practices guided by Mauricio Gaviria, biologist, sintergetic physician and advanced Oxygen Advantage instructor, aimed at regulating the nervous system, improving sleep, reducing stress and strengthening the immune system through conscious breathing, bioenergetics and controlled cold exposure in a natural setting in the Coffee Cultural Landscape.
reco: Mobile activity: held at the hotel or venue where the passengers are staying.
Ideal for ages 6 to 80.

cataquesos.name: Aged Single-Origin Cheese Tasting
cataquesos.tagline: A unique sensory journey. In a special setting, an organoleptic experience in which you will discover three carefully selected aged cheeses.
desc: A unique sensory journey. In a special setting, an organoleptic experience in which you will discover three carefully selected aged cheeses. An expert guides the tasting, explaining how to savor them and perceive their organoleptic nuances, exploring retronasal sensations, aftertaste and persistence in every bite. In addition, a pairing with selected wines perfectly complements the experience, enhancing the flavors and creating unrivaled harmony between the cheeses, the wines and ancestral culinary delights.
reco: Not recommended for people with food allergies.
The tasting may include gouda, achiote, blue, camembert, aged and semi-aged cheeses.
Mobile activity (hotel or venue).
Ideal for ages 6 to 80.

catacocteles.name: Signature Cocktail Tasting
catacocteles.tagline: Five signature cocktails with an expert bartender who shares the story and technique behind each one.
desc: Guided by a cocktail expert, participants explore the alchemy behind each drink. Through a selection of 5 signature cocktails, each preparation reveals a story told through aromas, textures and nuances that awaken the senses, all in a vibrant, energetic atmosphere.
reco: Held in the city's urban area.
Minimum 5 and maximum 14 people.
Ideal for ages 18 to 80.

catacafe.name: Specialty Coffee Cupping
catacafe.tagline: From bean to cup: learn to identify the citrus, chocolate or spicy notes of specialty coffee, the product that made the region famous worldwide.
desc: Embark on a sensory journey from bean to cup. In this exclusive experience, you will learn to decode the hidden notes (citrus, chocolate, spice) that define specialty coffee. It is not just tasting; it is mastering the art of cupping and connecting deeply with the origin and culture behind every sip. A must for travelers seeking authenticity and distinction.
reco: Can be held at the hotel or venue where the passengers are staying.
Ideal for ages 18 to 80.

gastronomica.name: Gastronomic Experience: Colombia on a Plate
gastronomica.tagline: A seven-course dinner created by a chef that travels through Colombia's regions (Orinoquía, Amazon, Pacific, Caribbean and Andes), with a surprise dish of cacao,…
desc: A unique seven-course experience offering a journey through the country's most representative regions: Orinoquía, Amazon, Pacific, Caribbean and Eastern Andes. Participants enjoy native flavors in dishes made with local products, carefully designed by a chef. The experience includes a surprise signature dish with influences of cacao, coffee, rum and chocolate. An unrivaled opportunity to explore Colombia's rich cuisine.

romelia.name: Visit to La Romelia · Orchids and Exotic Fruits
romelia.tagline: A farm in Manizales devoted to orchids, bonsai and fruit trees: travelers tour the nurseries with a guide, visit the main house and taste fruit from…
desc: A farm in Manizales devoted to orchids, bonsai and fruit trees: travelers tour the nurseries with a guide, visit the main house and taste fruit from the farm, in the country with the most orchid species in the world. incl: Guided visit (about 3 h) of the orchid, bonsai and fruit-tree nurseries
Tasting of fruit from the farm

gen: Rates are subject to availability and rate validity.

menores: Children aged 0 to 2 do not pay but occupy a child seat in the vehicle; from age 3 the rate applies.

Passengers traveling with children under 18 must present the child's birth certificate or identity card showing the relationship. If the minor is not their child, they must attach a copy of the parents' ID documents, the minor's birth certificate and a notarized letter of authorization from the parents with the details of the responsible adult.
Espontáneos Travel protects minors in compliance with Article 17 of Law 679 of 2001 and Law 1336 of 2009 on the prevention of exploitation, pornography and sex tourism involving minors.
about: We are a tour operator specializing in the creation and operation of experiences in Colombia's Coffee Cultural Landscape. We work alongside travel agencies, DMCs, wholesalers and event organizers, providing reliable and flexible solutions for their operations in the region.

We offer tours, transfers and hotel services in Risaralda, Caldas, Quindío and Norte del Valle. Our portfolio includes coffee tours, nature activities, cultural experiences and community-based offerings, designed so that our partners can offer authentic, differentiated products.

Our team—certified guides, partner transport providers and specialized advisors—supports the entire process, from planning to execution, with constant support and attention to detail. Our commitment is to be a strategic partner: quality, reliability and memorable experiences for our trade partners' passengers.
condiciones.accesible: We hold Accessible Tourism certification (CIDCA – ProColombia 2025) and design and operate accessible products for wheelchair users, people with reduced mobility and blind people (ask about rates and adjustments). We were pioneers in operating the first accessible tourism fam trip in the Coffee Region.
iconos: Community: experience led together with the local community (farmers, artisans, local producers).
Paisaje Cordillerano (mountain landscape): tours that are part of the project in Calarcá, Córdoba, Pijao, Buenavista and Génova (Quindío) and Caicedonia and Sevilla (Valle del Cauca).
Languages: indicates that the tour can be conducted in that language regardless of the bilingual guide (ask which farms this applies to).
Agencies only: sales and operational data for DMCs and agencies; not included in the final-client PDF.
Codes: HD = half day (under 7 h); FD = full day (7 h or more); PT = theme parks.
condiciones.sost: Creating social value for rural communities is part of the philosophy on which Espontáneos Travel was founded: rescuing their traditions, cultures and origins. We involve travelers in farm activities so they understand the importance of natural, cultural, ancestral and historical resources, and we support and advise communities so they can carry out their activities while caring for ecosystems, within a circular economy.
acciones: Responsible tourism and tours with social and environmental awareness.
We promote buying local and contribute to circular economies.
Tree planting and activities that include it.
We say NO to single-use plastics on our tours.
We advise and support local community projects.

comunidad.t: Cacao venture led by a rural woman
comunidad.p: Doralba opened her farm to share a cacao experience. We supported the design and structuring of her cacao route: more income for her family and visibility for female leadership in the countryside.

We integrated the creations of a group of women artisans from Armenia as souvenirs in our experiences and created the campaign “10,000 hummingbirds for a dream” to fund their participation in an international fair in Milan.

Coffee tastings and direct encounters with producers generate direct income for the coffee community. Since 2023, a virtual catalog has made it possible to buy coffee, cacao and handicrafts without intermediaries.
We supported three new rural producers, including coffee farms, in designing tours for foreign markets, training for business roundtables and marketing.
